Changes how strong the pitch shift of moving 3D sounds is, which [CreateListener](CreateListener) sets first. A game that leaves a planet for space can turn the shift down as the air goes, without a new listener. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Leaving the atmosphere: no doppler shift after five seconds.
ListenerDoppler 0, 5000
```
@param value  `0` turns the shift off, `1` is the real one and `2` shifts twice as far. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new value. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap [ChannelDoppler](ChannelDoppler) scales it for one channel on top. [GetListenerDoppler](GetListenerDoppler) tells the value.
